name: Primary Bone Dysplasia with Multiple Joint Dislocations
aliases: Congenital Bone Dysplasia with Joint Laxity
Hereditary Bone Dysplasia with Recurrent Joint Dislocations

criteria.description: Presence of recurrent or multiple congenital joint dislocations
Radiographic evidence of generalized bone dysplasia with abnormal bone modeling
Clinical evidence of connective tissue laxity contributing to joint instability
Positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant or recessive inheritance

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of multiple joint dislocations and radiographic bone dysplasia findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not always definitive.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Generalized bone dysplasia with abnormal bone morphology
searchTerms: bone dysplasia with unusual bone structure

common.symptomName: Short stature due to skeletal abnormalities
searchTerms: small stature due to skeletal defects
short body caused by bone abnormalities

common.symptomName: Delayed motor milestones secondary to joint instability
searchTerms: delayed movement due to unstable joints
slow motor skills from joint looseness

common.symptomName: Mild joint pain related to recurrent dislocations

occasional.symptomName: Recurrent respiratory infections due to chest wall deformities
searchTerms: recurrent lung infections from chest deformity
breathing infections due to rib cage issues

laboratory: Possible mild elevation of alkaline phosphatase reflecting bone turnover
imaging: Radiographs showing generalized bone dysplasia with metaphyseal irregularities
Multiple joint dislocations visible on X-ray
genetic: Mutations in genes related to connective tissue and bone development (e.g., COL2A1, FLNB) in some cases
other: Clinical assessment of joint laxity using Beighton score or similar scales

distinguishingFeatures: Variable joint dislocations but usually less severe
Primary involvement of spine and epiphyses

redFlags: Progressive neurological deficits indicating spinal cord compression
Severe recurrent joint dislocations causing neurovascular compromise
Early onset respiratory insufficiency due to chest wall deformities
references: Orphanet: Primary Bone Dysplasia with Multiple Joint Dislocations - ORPHA:93441
Superti-Furga A, Unger S. Nosology and classification of genetic skeletal disorders: 2019 revision. Am J Med Genet A. 2019.
Marini JC, Forlino A. Heritable disorders of connective tissue and skeletal dysplasias. In: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 20th Ed.
